metadata.description: Claude Code skills for product work rather than code — Figma files and product specs

plugins.name: fig
plugins.description: A bundle for a Figma file several people share. It builds your to-draw list before you start, draws each screen anchored to your file's own conventions, and keeps the canonical page current afterwards.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: A bundle for product docs and the tasks that come out of them. Write a spec against a format and verify it before it ships; turn a request thread into a task's context table; file that task in your engineering tracker and keep the two sides reconciled. Where things are stored is decided by config.
